_readme: Docs past the staleness threshold that have a RECORDED DECISION instead of a fix.
Two honest states, and the difference matters:
verified_current — somebody READ it and the content is still true. Say what you checked.
pending_review   — its subject still exists so the doc is plausibly fine, but NOBODY HAS
READ IT. Carries a review_by deadline; the test fails when it passes.
Conflating the two is how an unread document becomes an endorsed one.
When review happens: archiving is usually the right move — a doc that no longer describes
the system is worse than no doc, because it is discoverable and confident. If it must be
brought current, read-then-WRITE the whole file; an edit keeps the old structure and
strands every reference to what it changed.
